class.name: NetwMemberConfig
class.brief_description: Network settings for an RPC, a signal, a spawn function or a property.
class.description: Returned by [method Netw.configure_rpc], [method Netw.configure_signal] and [method Netw.configure_spawn]. [method Netw.configure_property] returns a [NetwPropertyConfig], which extends it. The methods set who may send, how it is sent, and what the receiver does. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_rpc(self.fire).unreliable().controller_only() Netw.configure_signal(self.exploded).any_peer() Netw.configure_spawn(self._spawn_bullet).quantize(dir_q) [/codeblock] Settings are stored per script, so calling this in [method Object._init] of every instance is fine. A warning is pushed only when two calls set different values. [b]Note:[/b] these methods return a [NetwMemberConfig], so call [NetwPropertyConfig] methods first in a chain. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state().quantize(pos_q) # works Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").quantize(pos_q).state() # state() is not found [/codeblock]

method.name: any_peer
method.description: Any peer may send it. Only use it when a cheating client cannot do harm.

method.name: authority
method.description: Only the node's multiplayer authority may send it. The default.

method.name: call_local
method.description: The signal or RPC also runs on the sender. The default for [method Netw.configure_signal]. Not valid on a property.

method.name: call_remote
method.description: The signal or RPC only runs on other peers. The default for [method Netw.configure_rpc]. Not valid on a property.

method.name: controller
method.description: Only the [member NetwEntity.controller] may send it.

method.name: controller_only
method.description: Only the [member NetwEntity.controller] or the server may call this RPC.

method.name: defer_until
method.description: A received call waits until [param sig] is emitted on the node, such as [code]self.ready[/code].

method.name: interpolate
method.description: Smooths received values with one [NetwInterpolate] per argument, in order. [code]null[/code] leaves an argument unsmoothed. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").interpolate(pos_lerp) Netw.configure_signal(self.aimed).interpolate(null, dir_slerp) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_interpolation_only
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when only [method interpolate] was called, and no other setting.

method.name: is_policy_declared
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [member write_policy] was set, even to its default.

method.name: is_transfer_declared
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [member transfer_mode] was set, even to its default.

method.name: quantize
method.description: Compresses each argument with one [NetwQuantize], in order. [code]null[/code] sends an argument as is. The number of quantizers must match the number of arguments. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").quantize(pos_q) Netw.configure_rpc(self.fire).quantize(dir_q, null, power_q) [/codeblock]

members.member: The name of the method, property or signal.
A weak reference to the node a property was declared on, used to read the property's type.
The script that declares the member, or [code]null[/code] for a node without a script.
[code]0[/code] for an RPC or spawn function, [code]1[/code] for a property, [code]2[/code] for a signal.
Set by [method authority], [method controller] and [method any_peer].

constants.constant: Only the node's multiplayer authority may send.
